label: Mentions another person possibly connected to the event
reason: Mentions another person in connection with the event.

label: Mentions a benefit, payment, deal, leniency or relocation for a witness
reason: Mentions whether a benefit was offered.

label: Differs from another statement by the same person
reason: Mentions a difference between statements attributed to the same person.

label: Mentions information bearing on a witness's reliability (e.g., impairment, vision, distance, prior reports)
reason: Mentions conditions affecting an observation or recollection.
patterns: \b(?:impaired|intoxicated|poor vision|blurred vision|without (?:my |their |her |his )?glasses|poor lighting|too far|distance of \d+|could not hear|could not see clearly)\b

label: Expresses uncertainty in an identification or observation
reason: Mentions uncertainty about an identification or observation.
patterns: \b(?:not sure|unsure|uncertain|could not identify|couldn.t identify|might have been|may have been|cannot identify|could not tell|couldn.t tell)\b

label: Mentions a lead, test or record that was requested, not done or not located
reason: Mentions the status of a requested lead, test or record.

label: Mentions physical or forensic results that don't match the stated account
reason: Mentions a physical or forensic result differing from an account or comparison.
patterns: \b(?:did not match|does not match|didn.t match|excluded|excludes|incompatible with|different from|no match|not consistent with)\b
